0.name: TEXT_REGNOR4TOMRA_00594_MAGUTT_000_000
0.description: Lali-ho! Welcome to Tomra, friend. If you've any questions to ask, then I'm your dwarf!

3.name: TEXT_REGNOR4TOMRA_00594_A1_000_002
3.description: What kind of place is this?

5.name: TEXT_REGNOR4TOMRA_00594_MAGUTT_000_010
5.description: I was a miner once, but my days of swinging a pick came to an end when my back got too old and twisted. Now I'm just enjoying my golden years!

6.name: TEXT_REGNOR4TOMRA_00594_MAGUTT_000_011
6.description: I sit here, drinking good dwarven ale, and pass the time boasting about whose beard is best. Mine may be old, but it ain't lost none of its bounce!

7.name: TEXT_REGNOR4TOMRA_00594_MAGUTT_000_020
7.description: This village is home to the Tholl family.

8.name: TEXT_REGNOR4TOMRA_00594_MAGUTT_000_021
8.description: We mostly make a living from what we dig out of the mines. You'll also see a few hunters and farmers around the place, not to mention our automata─those are the metal helpers what we build to assist with our daily tasks.

9.name: TEXT_REGNOR4TOMRA_00594_MAGUTT_000_022
9.description: Oh, one word of advice if you're headed east: take care around them Goggs. You can't trust dwarves with wild, wiry beards like that lot! Just the sight of them shifty buggers is enough to make my whiskers curl... <spit>
